turns.text: You were there the whole time!
Did you have a nice Christmas?
What's your favorite bit about Christmas?
turns.zh: 你最喜欢圣诞节的哪一点？

turns.text: My favorite part about Christmas was… Me being there.
turns.zh: 我最喜欢圣诞节的一点是……就是我在场。
